llamacpp-heavy.note: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite Q4_K_M; chart default ctx 4096, 24 GPU layers. Deploy: helm upgrade ... --set modelTier=heavy

llamacpp-full.note: Mistral-Nemo-12B Q4_K_M; chart default ctx 8192, all layers on GPU. Deploy: helm upgrade ... --set modelTier=full (the runner refuses if the server runs another tier)

ollama-heavy.note: CPU-ONLY unless the Ollama pod has been given the GPU (the chart does not do this yet); check cold_start residency / ollama_vram_fraction

strata-heavy.note: NOT IMPLEMENTED: placeholder for the Strata spike (OpenAI-compatible, MoE only; its DeepSeek-V2-Lite is not the same model as DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite)

vllm.note: Placeholder until vLLM is enabled on the chart
